name: manual_705894
claim: OpenClaw seats biafra (MetaResearcher, guardian and companion of autoresearcher) and autoresearcher both default to openai/gpt-6.1-terra at medium, then fall back to W&B, Google, Ollama, OpenRouter free; Astra and Sol are human-gated and set only on explicit operator approval, and W&B is never removed from any agent chain.

decisions.notes: Operator ruling 2026-11-26 superseding the same-day first assignment of Astra to biafra and Sol to autoresearcher. Their OpenAI login is per agent for these two seats only, never the gateway or main.

rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-26 superseding the same-day first assignment of Astra to biafra and Sol to autoresearcher. Their OpenAI login is per agent for these two seats only, never the gateway or main.
